notes.title: Patch 1.2.2
notes.content:
Patch 1.2.2

Login/Register
- New users doesn't need to register anymore, the steam username will be used instead
- Current users need to link his current account with the steam account (Send me message)

Customization
- Now 2D/3D Notes Speed are separated

In-Game
- Beatmap Notes Speed are now scaled by the BPM
- Now the option for showing/hiding rankings during gameplay are saved

notes.title: (v1.2) NEW UI AND MORE CHANGES
notes.content:
[h1][b]Update 1.2 BETA[/b][/h1]

[b]NEW[/b]
- Home Screen New UI
- Song Selection New UI
- UserProfile New UI
- Rankings now shows your current ranking per separated

[b]FIXES[/b]
- Your level is now displayed correctly and the experience is working again
- Now the minimum level is 1 (previously 0)
- Outdated beatmaps will notify you to update them
- If the beatmap doesn't have rankings it will show "No rankings" instead
- Rankings and Performance change animation are now working again!

notes.title: UPDATE 1.1.5 BETA
notes.content:
Made some changes to the gameplay

[h1]GAMEPLAY[/h1]
[h2]▶️ TIMES OF TOLERANCE[/h2]

[b]MAX:[/b] [strike]20MS[/strike] -> 50MS
[b]PERFECT:[/b] [strike]60ms[/strike] -> 65MS
[b]EXCELLENT:[/b] 85MS
[b]GOOD:[/b] 100MS
[b]ACCEPTABLE:[/b] 125MS

"This means that it is now easier to get MAX and PERFECT grades."

We will keep changing these values until we find the right ones.
Please send your suggestions in our Discord community.

[h1]NEW[/h1]
[h2]Intro Screen[/h2]
"There is now an introduction screen that will ask you for initial setup information."

[h2]HINTS[/h2]
"There are now texts during loading screens that will display hints."

This is just preparing for the next big updates!

tags.feature: There is now an introduction screen that will ask you for initial setup information.
There are now texts during loading screens that will display hints.

notes.title: 1.1.3 Update
notes.content:
After some time, we continue the development.


[h1][b]New Mods[/b][/h1]
[list]
[*] Daycore (-25% tone and speed)
[*] Nightcore no speed (+25% tone only)
[*] Daycore no speed (-25% tone only)
[/list]

[h2][b]WAV files support disabled[/b][/h2]
There is no reason to support these files because it increases loading times, and cannot be submitted in the server because by his size.

[b]- Beatmaps with difficulty of 3.8+ are considered insane (previously was from 4.0)[/b]

[b] - Now the name of the beatmaps that are in the process of creation, are called in "In development" (before it was "In process") [/b]

[h2][b]Fixes: [/b][/h2]

Username character limit and registration was distinct

notes.title: Great Update v1.1
notes.content:
[h1]Beatmaps difficulties changed[/h1]

[b]We focus in this:[/b]
[list]
[*] Reduce the difficulty difference in beatmaps with more or less keys
[*] Increase overall difficulty values to make a more noticeable difference
[*] Focus more in the fastest notes to create a more realistic calculated difficulty
[/list]

[h1]Total Performance Recalculated[/h1]
Because the performance has been recalculated, you now have a new total performance based in your rankings!

[h1]4K, 7K and Standard modes World Rankings separated[/h1]
Now these modes has separated world rankings and performances!

[h1]FPS Camera and game history in the Home scene[/h1]
Now you can press 'Home' key to enter the FPS camera and see the Lynium history!

[h2]Other changes...[/h2]

[list]
[*] [h3]Fixed get #1 in one beatmap achievement[/h3]
[*] [h3]Difficulty color values have been changed[/h3]
[*] [h3]Added open beatmaps folder to the Creation mode[/h3]
[*] [h3]Fixed discord link[/h3]
[*] [h3]Added most recent beatmaps button to Beatmaps Downloads[/h3]
[/list]

notes.title: Update 1.0.9
notes.content:
- We added a new Filter called "Mode"
This filter helps you to only show your preffered beatmaps.
Like 4K/7K only, Mania Only Maps, or Standard

- We fixed an error loading empty *.lym files (the beatmaps).
(Previously are loaded with no information, now are NOT loaded)

- We set in the Customize section 'Normal - 2D' velocity and 'Normal - 3D' velocity.

- In the Home Scene 
- You can press 'Home' button to display the FPS Camera
- Use the key 'Delete' to change the rotation of the visualization
- Use the key 'Page Up/Down' to change the visualization

More features will be added in the home scene soon!
